title: The last partial page is missing from page_count
body: `page_count` in `listing/paging.py` uses floor division, so 11 items with 5 per page report 2 pages and the eleventh item can never be shown. It should round up (0 items means 0 pages). A `per_page` below 1 currently fails with `ZeroDivisionError` or returns nonsense; it should raise `ValueError`.
